tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring, API Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, REST/OCC APIs and microservices. Proven record of designing PIM-ERP-MDM integrations, headless commerce APIs, CI/CD pipelines and cloud deployments. Strong techno-functional consultant: gathering requirements, writing user stories, and supporting production in agile, international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC)
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Priyanka Rani’s focus on reliable talent delivery for Salesforce Commerce Cloud projects. With over five years of end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud development at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep e-commerce platform expertise and a proven ability to deliver high-quality integrations.

bullets.label: API Integration
bullets.text: Designed and exposed OCC REST APIs and built PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines, ensuring seamless integration between ERP, MDM and external services.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Worked directly with business stakeholders to analyse requirements, write user stories and functional specs, translating them into robust commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & CI/CD
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within Scrum teams, accelerating release cadence and maintaining high code quality.

bullets.label: Performance Optimization
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring and optimized FlexibleSearch, reducing response latency and improving transaction throughput.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany with a valid work permit. Serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026. Open to remote, hybrid or on-site collaboration.

tailoring.why_company: I want to join Priyanka Rani because its commitment to delivering top-tier Salesforce Commerce Cloud talent aligns with my passion for e-commerce platform excellence. My background in complex SAP Commerce Cloud integrations and agile delivery equips me to contribute immediately to your clients’ success and to grow within a forward-thinking talent-focused organization.
tailoring.motivation_short: Leverage my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to drive successful e-commerce integrations for your SFCC clients, while growing in a dynamic talent-delivery environment.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of API and integration experience. I’m eager to support your Salesforce Commerce Cloud talent needs. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Salesforce Commerce Cloud role. With over five years of senior SAP Commerce Cloud development at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong Java, Spring and API integration expertise, ready to contribute to your projects.

Kind regards,
